rows.row: still_owed[0] - the paired run never reads the sandbox's Stderr
rows.why_it_was_wrong: The claim came from grepping internal/domain for the identifier `Stderr` and finding none. The field is never named in the consumer because the whole sandbox.Receipt value is appended to the record and marshalled, so the bytes travel without the name ever appearing. Every link of the path is resolved below; none of them is inferred.

verified_chain.step: the sandbox captures both streams for the arm
the whole receipt, so both streams, goes onto the record
the record is persisted as the execution body
verified_chain.verbatim: if _, e = tx.Exec("UPDATE experiment_executions SET state=?,body=?,receipt_hash=? WHERE project=? AND experiment=? AND run=? AND epoch=? AND state='RESERVED'", record["st

verified_chain.step: and the receipts are sealed as one artifact
verified_chain.verbatim: if _, e := seal("native-runtime.json", "LOG", Bytes(Object{"sandbox_receipts": record["sandbox_receipts"], "run_id": r["id"], "lease_epoch": r["lease_epoch"]})); e != nil

rows.chain_broken_at: no link is broken: stderr is captured, recorded, persisted and sealed

what_is_actually_true.observation: the per-arm hash covers stdout only
and the per-arm sealed raw artifact is stdout only
stderr's integrity therefore rides on the single combined native-runtime.json digest
what_is_actually_true.verbatim: if _, e := seal("native-runtime.json", "LOG", Bytes(Object{"sandbox_receipts": record["sandbox_receipts"], "run_id": r["id"], "lease_epoch": r["lease_epoch"]})); e != nil

rows.consequence_for_the_card: action 2 ('保留stdout/stderr/exit/原始测量') is met for retention. The narrower residual is that only stdout gets a per-arm digest and a per-arm raw artifact; stderr is verifiable only through the combined runtime artifact. No product change is made on this card for that, because the combined seal already covers the bytes and changing the sealed artifact set would move what accepted A07 rows observe.

rows.row: still_owed[1] - the run-retention refusal has no test witness
rows.why_the_measurement_needed_fixing: the original probe searched for the literal refusal sentence in test files. That only finds a test that quotes the message; a test could reach the gate without ever naming it. The correct probe looks for the shape - which submissions pass a frozen run list versus a shortened one - listed per file below.

delivered_by.construction: two tasks bound while the experiment is REGISTERED, because BindExperimentTask refuses any later status and a reported task cannot be re-claimed (only READY tasks can be claimed, observed as 409 STATE_CONFLICT in this card's own row)

rows.row: still_owed[2] - the declared key cannot route --check-id W10-01
rows.note: measured from execution/v2.4/commands.json and execution/commands.json in the same build as the map; nothing in this correction touches it.

method_change: An absence claim about behaviour now requires the data flow, not the identifier: a value can be persisted, hashed and sealed entirely through struct marshalling. The map's own self-proving rule caught four bad quotes but could not catch this, because a regex over file text is the wrong instrument for a question about a value's path.
